title: Learning piano at his godmother's house
summary: He could only practice on his godmother's piano when her husband was not sleeping or she was in a good mood.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Thank you. Thank you. if you ever had to practice very much? If you could get to a piano often enough to practice, or did it take much practice?

Well, I'll tell you how that was. My godmother had a piano, see? And I could only get to play it whenever, you know, her husband wasn't sleeping, or if she was in a good mood, well, then I'd get a chance to play. But other than that, I couldn't get to the piano.
